translation.name: Raraŋ Aetaniacna Kam Wembaŋ Laŋ
translation.englishName: New Testament in Mborena Kam language

content: Iesusa meikramtaɨrmo Wɨktɨtɨkna Ramo aiŋa mona wandɨk tɨkna kam ndoprina
Iŋmbaina Wɨktɨtɨkna Ra ianna Iesusapa mana iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨra mina witna warɨŋembta inikca anna mbukca taŋrina. Na mana iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨra nikembwataica mina wittarta lour aŋgɨca maammbat.
Ri, Parisina ramtaɨra an mbatca, mina mamo aindopatna, “Watwa, una iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨra, an Wɨktɨtɨkna Ra moapekna tɨpna kirara anna wandɨk.”
Karica ma mina kammo rutica aindopatna, “Eee, Dewitta morina reacna nininia ne Raraŋ Aetaniacna timbigta kapna inikca mba tikca watri, a? Manapa mana ramtaɨra nikembwataica, mina morina reac.

Dewitta Raraŋ Aetaniacna Ndamma mbukca, ma Raraŋ Aetaniacna outta tɨkca gɨmbamba moatna tapac aŋgɨca ndona ramtaɨrap ambrina. Na an tapaca wandɨkapnan, na taup ndamtaɨra ndori tiŋgikca man ambrenan. Na ne an kamma mba watre ki, a?

Na ne mba an Tɨp Wandɨkna timbigta kapna inikna kamma ne an toco mba watri, a? Na an kamma ma aindoprina, taup ndamtaɨra an Wɨktɨtɨkna Ra mina Raraŋ Aetaniacna Ndammo aiŋa mori, na mina an ramo aiŋa moreke, mina Tɨp Wandɨkca mo ŋgocrairina, na mina makukar kocor.
Ainda moca aku nemo aindopnande, an reaca ma Raraŋ Aetaniacna Ndammo ma kunda tamuŋmbai ndeacrenanna, mandeaca ma gan maeacreke.

Na ne an Raraŋ Aetaniacna timbigta kap ndeacrina kamna mɨnɨŋmo matau lamŋi te, ma aindoprina, ‘Aku gɨmbamba mba toŋgorenanna, aku kakadmaina opotacna tɨpna kirara toŋgorena.’ Te, ne an makukar ŋgocorta meikramtaɨrmo, ne minmo makukara moraŋna kambca mba mbopitndai.
Aintik Ramootna Nuoca ma Wɨktɨtɨkna Rana Kacoot.”
Wɨktɨtɨkna Ra Iesusa ramoot ianna par menaca eacrenanmo moa laŋa moatna
Karica Iesusa an taup tɨkcarica ma taŋga mina Iudananta mimitpac aŋgɨrena kac mambukat.

Ri, par memenacna ramoot ianna ma anna inik ndeacrina. Na ramtaɨr ndeida, mina mamo ritri waparaca mona moca, mina manmo gainda digiatna, “Aia roumbbebta meikramtaɨrmo Wɨktɨtɨkna Ra mbuŋa moi laŋa moit ki? Wanaiŋ?”
Karica ma minmo rutica aindopatna, “Na nena rɨkna ramoot ianna mana sipsip ianna Wɨktɨtɨkna Ra au ŋgirik te, ne lamŋinande, an ramootta ma an sipsipmo au inikca tɨkca aŋgɨca gacnande.
Na ramootta ma sipsipmo tamuŋmbai, aintik aia tɨp kirar laŋmo Wɨktɨtɨkna Ra aia monande.”
Karica ma an ramootmo aindopatna, “U ndona parmo lotai.” Ri, ma ndona parmo lotaia, an para laŋ mamori, an mana par waŋembaina kirar toc.
Ri, Parisina ramtaɨra ŋgepca an kac tɨkcarica, mina taŋga punica Iesusa mo menacna kam maleacat.
Iesusa ma Raraŋ Aetaniacna aiŋa morena ramoot ŋgoin

Na Iesusa ma an Parisina ramtaɨra mana mona ndopatna reaca, ma lamŋire tik, ma an auŋ tɨkcarica mataŋgat, na meikramtaɨr wɨt aniaca mana raŋgaica, ma an roumbbebtanmo, mina roumbbebca muruŋa moa laiŋ mamori.
Ri, ma minmo wandɨk tɨkca, minmo ndoa moi raekca kai mo laru teac, ma mandai ŋgoin.
Ma ainda mori tik, an Raraŋ Aetaniacna ramma morina ramoot Aisaia mbopatna reaca malaruri.

Na ma aindoprina, “Ganna aukna aiŋna ramoot, aku ndo mamo babuatna. Na aku mamo mamatŋi aniacap, na aukna nikinik iro toco mamo toŋtoŋ ŋgoin, na aku mamo ndona Ŋeroŋ neaŋca ma Iudana meikramtaɨr wanaiŋnanmo tɨpemb kirarir wandoik laiŋta kamb topna.
Na ma mba kaega moitndai, co, kam aniaca keca mbopitndai, na meikramtaɨrmo taupca punica kamb anik keca minmo mba mbopitndai.

Na tukunna rɨmbɨtta koaca eacrenanna, an ramootta ma an tukunmo mba rɨmbɨtitndai, na tac memetaca matau wɨr kocortanna an ramootta ma an tac memetacmo mba mo pikitndai. Na an ramootta ma aiŋa mo taŋca Raraŋ Aetaniacna tɨp kirara mo te, meikramtaɨra anna watca raŋgaina.
Te, rɨtɨpac mbuŋa Iudana meikramtaɨr wanaiŋa mina Iesusna i mbuŋa ndorimo otacna lambinande.”
Ramoot Mbɨkca, mana i ianna Belsebul, na meikramtaɨr ndeida gaindoprena Iesusa manap tɨkca aiŋa morena

Karica an mɨnna mina Iesusmo ŋeroŋ ŋgoreacap eacrina ramoot ianmo, mina aŋgɨca man ndambuŋ makɨpat. Na an ŋeroŋ ŋgoreacapna ramootta mana kamma ŋeroŋ ŋgoreaca leaca, ma kam ndop ŋgocor, na mana lamnɨaca ŋgoreac tɨk ma mba watrenanna. Ri, ma mana ŋeroŋ ŋgoreaca moa kecariri, ma kam ndopri, na ma mawatri.
Karica meikramtaɨra muruŋa an mbatca ŋgep ŋgoreac naŋgepca tamtam ndamŋica, aindopatna, “Gan ramootta ma Dewitna ŋgamaɨr ki?”
Ri, Parisina ramtaɨra an mbaraca mina aindoprina, “Gan ramootta ma Belsebulna gargar mbuŋa ŋerŋgaur ŋgorikca moa kecarirena. Na Belsebula ma ŋerŋgaur ŋgorikta gagrirta ramoot paŋan.”

Ainda moatke, ma mina landamŋia ma atuna malamŋiri, na ma minmo gaindopatna, “Pitrik ianna meikramtaɨr, mina ndorimo rɨkca titaca tumbun mbuniŋ ndaruca ndorica ruŋ te, mina ndorimo mo ŋgocrainande. Na auŋ aniac ian, co, kamin kabena meikramtaɨr, mina ndorita kɨdrɨkca tumbun mbuniŋa titaca ndorica ruŋ te, mina ndorita kaminna moa maŋgocraica.
Na Ramoot Mbɨkca, ma Ramoot Mbɨkmo mo kecari te, aia lamŋinande, ma ndomo moa matitacri. Na titocna gargar mbuŋa ma ndona reikmo raupŋit?

Na Belsebula aukmo otaca aku an ŋerŋgaur ŋgorikmo moa kecarirenanna, anna gidik co, na mandai ndo nena wiwitmo otacreke, mina an ŋerŋgaur ŋgorikca moa kecaririna? Na nena wiwitnanna ndori nenmo wandoŋa aindopnandet, an kamma ne mbopapeknanna anna gidikca wanaiŋ.
Na Raraŋ Aetaniacna Ŋeroŋa aukmo otaca, aku ŋerŋgaur ŋgorikca mo kecari te, ne lamŋi, Raraŋ Aetaniacna bubuoca nen ndambuŋ nakɨpca malaruri.

“Na titoca tɨk te, ramoot ianna kabena ramoot gargarna kaca mbukca mana reik aŋgɨit? Outta ma an ramoot gargarmo ŋgatɨk gargar mbuŋa leacnande. Na ma ainda mo te, ma an ramootna kacna reikca ma aŋgɨnande.
“Na ramootta, aukna aikndamootta wanaiŋ, ma aukmo ndona puŋndamootta monande. Na ramootta aukmo otaca meikramtaɨrmo aŋgɨri puni ŋgocor, ma ndo mimo aŋgɨri ootca mina tamtamma taŋ mainande.

“Aintik aku nemo aindopnande, Raraŋ Aetaniaca ma peperena kam ŋgorikcapa, tɨpemb ŋgorikta makukara ma muruŋa mo kecarinandet. Na ramootta Ŋeroŋ Ratmo peperena kam ŋgoreac ndop te, Raraŋ Aetaniaca an ramootna tɨp ŋgoreacna makukca mba mac mo kecariitndait.

Na ramootta Ramootna Nuocmo kam ŋgoreac ndop te, Raraŋ Aetaniaca mana an tɨp ŋgoreacna makukca ma mo kecarinande. Na ramootta Ŋeroŋ Ratmo kam ŋgoreac ndop te, Raraŋ Aetaniaca mana an tɨp ŋgoreacna makukmo ma mandeac, co, iŋmbaia ma mba mac mo kecariitndai.”
Ik ŋgoreac ma gagam ŋgoreaca errena

Karica Iesusa gaind mac mbopatna, “Ikca laŋ te, mana gagamma laŋ. Na ikca ŋgoreac te, mana gagam toca laŋa wanaiŋ. Meikramtaɨra mana errena gagamma wat te, mina aindopnande, anna ik laŋ, co, anna ik ŋgoreac.
Ne ramtaɨr ŋgorik, ne nduip ŋgorikta kirar. Na ne titoca tɨkca kamb laiŋ topit, a? Ramootta mana nikinik iro ndeacrena kambca ma ndona up mbuŋ ndoprena.

Na ramoot laŋ, mana nikinik iroa iroar laiŋ wɨtap eacrena. Aintik ma tɨpemb kirarir laiŋga morena. Na ramootta iro ŋgoreacap, mana nikinik iroa, iroar ŋgorikca mɨnna tɨkca eacrena. Aintik ma tɨpemb ŋgorikca morena.
“Na aku nemo aindopnande, Raraŋ Aetaniacna ritri waparacna ra, ma an kambca meikramtaɨra ndorimo tamtam ndoprinanna, ma anmo ŋganŋgɨnande.
Na una kam mbuŋa ma umo ŋganŋgɨca aindopnande, u ramoot wandoŋ, co, una kam mbuŋa ma umo aindopnande, u ramoot ŋgoreac.”
Ramtaɨr ndeida Iesusmo ŋgagatracara mona digiatna
Karica tɨpemb wandik tamŋirena ramtaɨr ndeidapa Parisina ramtaɨra Iesusmo aindopatna, “Riripti, aia ŋgagatrac ian mbat te, aia lamŋinande, u, Raraŋ Aetaniacna aiŋa morena.”

Ri, ma mina kammo rutica aindoprina, “Gan mɨnna meikramtaɨr, mina meikramtaɨr ŋgorik koind, na mina Raraŋ Aetaniacmo nikinik iro kabeapa wanaiŋ. Memetmbaca mina ŋgagatraca watna digirena. Na mina ŋgagatrac ianna mba watitndai, wanaiŋ ŋgoin. Mina ŋgagatrac kabe niŋgik mbatnande, na an ŋgagatraca ramma morina ramoot, Iounanan.
Mana ŋgagatraca ma ŋgoaem aniacna nikinik inikmo rai mbonkacapa mouŋemb mbonkacna mɨn ndeacrina, na Ramootna Nuoc toco, ma muk inikmo rai mbonkacapa mouŋemb mbonkacna mɨn ndeacnandet.

Na Raraŋ Aetaniacna ritri waparacna ra laru te, Niniwana ramtaɨra ŋgep wɨtɨkca gan mɨnna meikramtaɨrta tɨpemb ŋgorikmo ritri waparaca monande. Aintik mina Iounana neaŋgatna mimitpacna kamma waraca mina iroar inkara ŋgetrikirina. Na nena rɨk ndeacrena ramoot ian, ma Iounnamo, kunda tamuŋ ŋgoin.

Na Raraŋ Aetaniacna meikramtaɨrta makukara ritri waparacna ra laru te, mon tawan ŋgoinna raŋmbaina pitrikna auŋna gagrirta meac paŋan ianna ndo kɨpca gan mɨnna meikramtaɨr morena tɨpemb ŋgorikta tɨpembta ritri waparaca monande. Aintik an gagrirta meac paŋanna, ma ŋgaua mon tiacarpaikna mamaina auŋ ndeacrinanna, ma ndomo kɨpca Solomonna, ndona landamŋiar laiŋta kamb top te, ma ndomo anna waracna moca anna nakɨpatna. Na ramoot ianna gan ndeacrenanna, ma Solomonmo kunda tamuŋ ŋgoin.”
Ŋeroŋ ŋgoreaca mac nda mac makɨpat
Karica Iesusa gaind mac mbopatna, “Moca ŋeroŋ ŋgoreaca ramoot ian tɨkcarica, ma puik kocorta taupca ndo mbukca mbiraca wɨktɨkca eacna taupembta korena. Na ma taup ianna wat ŋgocor te,
ma aindopnande, ‘Aku mac nda taŋca ndona atu ndeacrina kac mac nda taŋna.’ Na ma taŋca an kaca wattatnanna anna meikramtaɨr kocor ndeacrenan, anna mina mataua maica laŋ ŋgoin ndeacrena.

Ainda moca ma nda taŋga kabena tɨpemb ŋgorik koindara morena ŋerŋgaur parmbaiapa mbut mbuniŋna mɨn naaŋgɨca kɨpca mina an kac ndeacnande. An ŋerŋgaura mina tɨpemb ŋgorikca mana tɨpemb ŋgorikmo minanna kunda tamuŋ ŋgoin ndeacrenan aŋgɨca kɨpca mina an kacna inik ndeac te, an ramootta ma ŋgaua laŋmbai ndeacrenanna, mandeaca ma kocnai ŋgocrainande. Na an tɨpna kirar kabea gan mɨnna meikramtaɨr ŋgorikmo larunande.”
Mandaia ndo Iesusna aemmapa laipitik
Karica Iesusa meikramtaɨrmo kam ndopri mbuŋa, mana aemmapa laipitikca kɨpca raekmbaia wɨtɨkca, na mina manap mbopna moca.
Ri, ramoot ianna manmo aindopatna, “U warac, una aemmapa laipitikca raekca wɨtɨkca eacrenanna, anna mina unap mbopna moca.”
Ainda moca ma mana kammo rutica aindoprina, “Mandaia aukna aem, na mandaia aukna laipitik, a?”
Karica ma ndona iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨrapa meikramtaɨrmo par mbuŋa wandaca aindopatna, “Wat, anna aukna aemmapa laipitikca gade.
Na mandaibinna aukna tamuŋna Aetna toŋtoŋa raŋgairenanna, anna mina aukna laipitikapa, mbiarpaikapa aukna amer.”

footnotes.text: Wɨktɨtɨkna Ra: Iudanaŋgepta Tɨp Wandɨkca aindoprena, Wɨktɨtɨkna Ra aiŋa momoa anna wandɨk. Na tɨp wandɨk ianna an ramo amna reac ŋgobacna aiŋa momoa anna wandɨk.

Parisina ramtaɨra gaind ndamŋirena, roumbbebapna meikramtaɨrmo Wɨktɨtɨkna Ra, mo laŋa morenanna anna aiŋa morena, aintik anna Parisina ramtaɨrmo mo nikkatca mina Iesusa mo menacna taupembta ŋgorerena.
